eula.initial:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent 2D game character animation atlas, four frames of one NEW secondary skill.
Input image: ONLY identity, costume, hairstyle, weapon and painterly Japanese fantasy rendering reference; not an edit target or background to copy.
Primary request: Eula, the same adult pale blue-haired ice greatsword swordswoman, in four distinct sequential articulated poses of a low horizontal greatsword sweep called Frostflower Breakwater. Preserve the elegant pale blue bob, feather hair ornament, black white royal blue and silver outfit, flowing cape panels, tall black boots and full-size ornate ice-blue greatsword.
Layout: square PNG with genuinely transparent RGBA background. Exactly TWO columns and TWO rows, four equal invisible cells, reading order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Each complete character, full weapon, hair and cape must stay within its own cell with large 15% empty transparent padding on every edge. Bodies must have the same physical scale in all four cells, same near-side three-quarter side camera, all facing RIGHT. Target standing human head-to-foot body height 55% of cell; knee bends may make the projected height shorter. Keep full sword length but use perspective when necessary. Wide EMPTY transparent gutters at central horizontal/vertical axes. No border or grid marks.
Frames:
1 top-left WINDUP: deep but stable low stance, both knees bent, hands holding greatsword drawn low behind the left hip, torso coiled for sweep toward right.
2 top-right CONTACT: front knee bent, hips/torso rotated right, both hands sweeping greatsword broadly and nearly horizontally toward RIGHT at waist level, blade fully extended ahead, no ice fan included (separate effect generated elsewhere).
3 bottom-left FOLLOWTHROUGH: lowest extended fencing-like stance after sweep, weight forward, arms and full sword extended low right, rear leg extended, cape sweeping behind.
4 bottom-right RECOVERY: rising toward guard facing right, sword drawn back diagonally close to side, a distinctly calmer pose.
Style: refined detailed hand-painted anime fantasy sprite, crisp silhouette and readable small-size anatomy, material highlights, consistent soft neutral lighting. Clear differences in arms, shoulders, spine, hips and legs across frames. Do not merely rotate one portrait.
Constraints: only these four individual character sprites. NO large magic effect, no ice fan, no circles, no clouds or ambient glow behind figures. An extremely fine cool edge light on sword is acceptable. NO backgrounds, ground shadows, labels, text, numerals, watermark, drawn grids or checkerboard. Real alpha transparency. Weapons never cross cell boundaries.

diluc.initial:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent game sprite atlas with four isolated SMALL character sprites, two columns by two rows.
Input reference: ONLY identity, costume, weapon and Japanese fantasy painting style, NOT a background or portrait layout.
Primary request: Diluc, the same adult red-haired greatsword wielder, performing the four distinct sequential articulated poses of a NEW upward sword launcher skill called Crimson Feather. Preserve long tied red hair, black ornate long coat with deep red lining, silver/gold trim, white shirt, black gloves/pants/boots, large red black silver greatsword.
CRITICAL sparse atlas composition: square RGBA image. Exactly TWO equal columns and TWO equal rows, reading top-left then top-right then bottom-left then bottom-right. Four SMALL separated full-body sprites. Around 80% of the canvas is completely empty transparent space. The complete sprite including FULL sword, every cape corner, hair and boots is MAXIMUM 55% of its own cell width and 55% cell height. At least 20% of a cell transparent margin on EVERY edge. Body standing anatomical height only around 40% cell height. Same body scale in every pose. Do NOT fill cells with large figures! Boots baseline near 77% each cell height. Pose center near x=48%. Full weapon tips never intersect central horizontal or vertical lines. Small sprite scale is critical.
Same near-side three-quarter camera, ALL facing RIGHT.
Frame1 TOPLEFT WINDUP: knees bent grounded stance, torso coiled right, both hands pull greatsword low behind hips to the LEFT in preparation for upward sweep.
Frame2 TOPRIGHT CONTACT: powerful grounded upward sweeping attack, straightening legs, torso driving upward/right, both hands carry blade diagonally up toward RIGHT above shoulder, full sword visible.
Frame3 BOTTOMLEFT FOLLOWTHROUGH: body extended nearly upright, sword finishing HIGH above the right shoulder, arms raised, coat swinging behind, full weapon and character still tiny enough to have large padding.
Frame4 BOTTOMRIGHT RECOVERY: returning to stable right-facing guard, sword lowering diagonally in front of body, distinctly relaxed followup.
No lunging running dash. Each frame has real different shoulder, hip, knee and hand articulation. This upward move must read differently from a forward flame dash.
Visual style: refined hand-painted Japanese anime fantasy sprite, crisp readable detailed costume, consistent neutral lighting and anatomy.
Effects are separately composited by game. No firebird in this image, no big flame ribbons, smoke, circles or glow backdrop; only subtle orange blade edge light okay. No floor, cast shadow, stage, checkerboard, labels, text, numbers, watermark, visible grid or border. Truly alpha transparent background. Four complete sprites only.

effects.initial:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent production videogame elemental effects atlas.
Primary request: Six DISTINCT detailed Japanese anime fantasy spell effects, each independently isolated as a sprite on genuinely transparent RGBA background. NO characters, weapons, scenery or text.
Layout: landscape image exactly THREE equal columns and TWO equal rows, all six invisible cells equal. Each effect is centered within its cell with at least 15% of cell width/height completely empty transparent padding on every edge. All effects are fully complete and never touch one another or cross cell boundaries. Clear broad gutters. No drawn grids/borders/checkerboard. Composition must remain readable when each sprite renders around 100 pixels in game. Transparent glow falloff okay; empty background alpha zero. Crisp white-hot cores, refined color gradients, elegant hand-painted sharp outer fragments, soft contained glow.
Specific reading order:
TOP LEFT: Raiden violet ELECTRO LIGHTNING COLUMN. A vertical jagged slender descending violet white lightning bolt, terminating in an elliptical purple electric ring at its base. Predominantly vertical compact silhouette, no horizontal travel.
TOP MIDDLE: Jean teal green UPDRAFT. A tapered upward spiraling stream of mint green wind ribbons with small feathers/light flecks, wider near bottom, rising clear tapered top. No solid tornado smoke.
TOP RIGHT: Eula icy cyan CRYSTAL FAN flying RIGHT. Several sharp crystalline ice shards spread toward right in a 60-degree fan, rooted at compact left origin, bright icy blue edges, delicate frost streaks. Unmistakably directional rightward.
BOTTOM LEFT: Diluc golden red FIREBIRD flying RIGHT. A stylized phoenix-like silhouette made entirely of brilliant gold orange scarlet flame, identifiable pointed beak facing right, spread fiery wings swept backward to left and flame tail trailing left. Clear energetic bird shape, no real flesh or feathers.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: Xiao emerald teal WIND SPEAR TRAIL flying RIGHT. A long horizontal concentrated lance of luminous pale teal wind with a pointed spear-like energy tip at right, elegant narrow spiraling emerald streamers trailing left. NOT vertical, no downward plunge; no physical weapon or character.
BOTTOM RIGHT: generic white cyan IMPACT BURST. Compact spiky star-shaped magical impact, white center and pale teal shards radiating all directions, simple readable silhouette.
Constraints: six independent effects only. Never mix palettes between cells. No backgrounds, full-canvas haze, smoke clouds filling cells, floors, cast shadows, characters, faces, letters, labels, numbers, watermarks, borders or grid marks. Each complete effect fits inside its own invisible cell with generous empty transparent margins.
